text: That Chest X-Ray finding of diffuse infiltrates is actually inconsistent with acute appendicitis, which typically presents with localized right lower quadrant pain and a normal chest X-ray. Given your symptoms of chronic cough and weight loss, the X-ray strongly suggests an underlying pulmonary condition like tuberculosis or lung cancer instead.
